title: About
body:
Scott's Story

My photographic journey began when I was thirteen. A day trip to the Wichita Mountains Wildlife Refuge in southwest Oklahoma and a brief stop at a nearby junk shop set my imagination in motion. It was there that I spied an old camera that my parents wisely convinced me to leave behind. Instead, after a few months of mowing lawns, I was finally able to purchase a new camera and devoted every free moment to learning the intricacies of that machine, the magic of the darkroom, and the art of seeing.

Many decades have passed since, and I still find myself drawn to wide open spaces, natural beauty, and those uniquely serendipitous moments where I feel compelled to capture and ultimately share them. My quest for this, in spaces both familiar and exotic, has been a driving force throughout my life. I count myself as exceedingly fortunate to have seen the world, but perhaps more importantly, to notice it in both grandeur and subtlety. It is a rich life to be sure.

My hope is that an image resonates with you in some special way that is uniquely yours and that you take joy in living with the image as much as I did in experiencing the moment.
